facts.fact: NOSi presented the Sistema Integrado de Registro de Atendimento dos Imigrantes (SIRA) on 24 July 2025, a platform the immigration authority's president said NOSi developed with the authority.
NOSi developed the immigrant-service registry platform SIRA for the Alta Autoridade para a Imigracao.
